title: Webb Telescope Reveals Deepest Infrared View of the Universe Yet
summary: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has captured its deepest and sharpest infrared image of the distant universe to date, revealing thousands of galaxies including faint structures never observed before.

title: Perseverance Rover Collects Key Mars Samples for Future Return Mission
summary: NASA's Perseverance rover has cached another set of rock and regolith samples on the Martian surface, part of a growing collection intended for eventual return to Earth for detailed laboratory analysis.

title: Europa Clipper Continues Journey to Study Icy Jovian Moon
summary: NASA's Europa Clipper spacecraft is en route to Jupiter's moon Europa, where it will investigate whether the icy moon's subsurface ocean could hold conditions suitable for life.

title: Sun Approaches Solar Maximum, Increasing Space Weather Activity
summary: Scientists tracking the current solar cycle report increasing sunspot activity as the Sun approaches solar maximum, driving more frequent solar flares and geomagnetic storms.

title: Astronomers Detect Atmospheric Signatures on Distant Exoplanet
summary: Using spectroscopic data, researchers have identified chemical signatures in the atmosphere of a distant exoplanet, offering new clues about planetary formation and potential habitability.
